comment: The four signal inputs are addressed by index arithmetic on the position (fluidmix.cpp:70, :71), which works because the position input happens to be input 0 and the four signals follow it. The CV is scaled by 0.3, so 10V covers the three steps from position 1 to position 4, which is what the README means by the whole range being covered by 10V.
